visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with glasses wearing a grey hoodie sits at a white table, holding a tall stack of six small white product boxes. The top box features a cartoon bunny character in a hexagon. Behind him is a bright indoor room with a yellow shelf. (2) Close-up shot of a hand pressing a final orange puzzle piece into a hexagonal puzzle featuring 'shisa'. The puzzle is held against a white background. (3) A close-up shows hands snapping a white piece into a purple hexagonal puzzle depicting 'momonga'. The character has a small flower near its ear. (4) Hands complete a blue hexagonal puzzle of 'hachiware', a blue and white cat character holding a trident. (5) A pink hexagonal puzzle of 'chiikawa' is completed with a final pink border piece. The character is a white creature with a pink bag. (6) A hand finishes an orange hexagonal puzzle of 'usagi', a yellow bunny character, by snapping in the top border. (7) An off-white hexagonal puzzle of 'rakko', a character holding a sword, is shown being completed and then tilted to show its texture. (8) A green hexagonal puzzle featuring 'kurimanju' holding a bottle and a mug is completed. (9) The man in the grey hoodie returns to the frame, fanning out several completed hexagonal puzzles towards the camera with a proud smile. (10) The camera pans across a white wall covered in many of these hexagonal puzzles, featuring characters from Chiikawa and Toy Story, creating a honeycomb-like pattern. (11) The man appears in a selfie-style shot, hugging a large yellow plushie shaped like one of the hexagonal puzzle pieces. He smiles, makes a peace sign, and leans against the decorated wall.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-tempo, upbeat electronic pop BGM starts immediately with female stylized vocals chanting 'Mm, mm-wah-wah-wah'. The beat is driving and synthesized. (2) A series of sharp, rhythmic 'pop' or 'click' SFX are layered over the music, each precisely synchronized with the visual of a puzzle piece snapping into place. The BGM maintains its high energy and vocal loops. (3) The rhythmic snaps continue at a steady pace as each puzzle phase transitions. The music transitions into a more melodic synth bridge with the same female vocal texture, maintaining a cheerful and satisfied acoustic tone. (4) The track concludes with a final swell of the BGM and a slightly more prominent bass beat, ending cleanly with the video's conclusion.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase the assembly and decorative appeal of Pintoo Wall Tile Puzzles featuring Chiikawa and other characters, emphasizing how easily they snap together and how they can be used for wall decor.
